⚠️ Alert: Beware of Fraudulent Job Postings and Offers:

We at Kyndryl have been made aware of an ongoing scam in which malicious actors impersonate Kyndryl or its representatives. These fraudulent schemes often appear as requests for employment opportunities. Scammers typically reach out via Telegram, Signal, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Facebook, email or other communication/messaging platforms.
Common Scam Tactics:
•	Fake Job Offers: Fraudsters send messages offering employment opportunities,  with often times requesting payment for recruitment processing. Kyndryl never charges candidates for job applications or interviews.
•	Non-Payment for Work: Victims may be asked to complete work for a “promised” fraudulent payment that never materializes.
•	Fake Email Correspondence: Messages may appear from unofficial email addresses, such as Kyndryl@gmail.com or recruiting@kyndryl-hr-help.com, and will falsely offer interviews or job placements.
How to Protect Yourself:
•	Kyndryl and its employees will never ask for payment for job applications, interviews, or project work.

d:
Anton Paar develops and manufactures high-quality measuring and analytical instruments for industrial and research applications. Founded in 1922, Anton Paar is a global leader in density, concentration, and CO₂ measurement, as well as in rheometry and material characterization solutions. The company’s state-of-the-art product portfolio includes X-ray diffraction (XRD), small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS), surface characterization instruments, viscometers, refractometers, polarimeters, FTIR spectrometers, thermal analysis systems, microwave synthesizers and digesters, petroleum testing instruments, particle characterization systems, and a wide range of laboratory and process instrumentation.

Anton Paar India Pvt. Ltd. is headquartered in Gurgaon, NCR Delhi, with sales and service centers located in Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. d:
myNachiketa Foundation is inspired by Nachiketa, a character in the Upanishads, who asks philosophical questions to Yama in his childhood. We seek to bring the philosophical ideas and concepts in Hinduism to children in creative ways. 

We are designing innovative products including books, games, workshops, etc. to bring this knowledge to kids. Our method is to encourage kids to question and think of various different ways of arriving at answers, rather than developing a regimented thought process. Our goal is to reach every Hindu kid globally with this knowledge, help them critically reason, and develop their own understanding based on exposure to various schools of Hindu philosophy.
Vision: Vivekananda introduced Hindu philosophy to adults, we will teach Hindu philosophy to children.

Mission: 
Make the new Hindu child an open-minded, inquiring, inclusive individual, one with awareness of the wealth of philosophical knowledge in the Hindu tradition, a critical thinker, a finder of his/her own way, and a helper for others in the process of discovery. 

Philosophy:
We do not give answers, we encourage kids to ask questions!
Nachiketa Foundation is dedicated to introducing the various Hindu Philosophical Schools to children. While we bring all different ideas and concepts to children, our emphasis is on the Upanishadic literature, the Bhagavad Gita and Vedanta.

Our aim is not to force any particular view on children, but to encourage them to ask questions, and discuss and debate topics constructively. We want children to think deeply about these topics and find their own answers. 

We always uphold the principle that there are many paths to God and one truth but seen variously.

name: Vezras
d:
Most businesses already have the tools they need. 

The problem is, they don’t always work together. 

Teams bring different numbers for the same metric. Critical information is scattered across systems, spreadsheets, emails and conversations. Managers spend time asking multiple people for answers. And by the time everything comes together, the moment to act may have already passed. 
 
Problems stay invisible until they're too big to ignore. Dependencies between teams go unnoticed until something breaks. Small decisions quietly create downstream consequences no one saw coming. And leaders are often the last to know — not because the signals weren't there, but because nothing connected them. 

Vezras is an Enterprise OS built to change how intelligence moves through a business. 

It gives the business a shared understanding of what is happening, what matters and what may happen next. 

By bringing the right context together, Vezras helps leaders see the implications of their choices before they act — not just what has happened, but where attention is needed and which decisions could have the greatest impact. 

Vezras activates a semantic intelligence layer across enterprise systems, data and tools; builds and maintains a living ontological fabric that reconciles data, process logic and institutional knowledge into a single, continuously updated semantic foundation ; deploys a coordinated multi-agent architecture where purpose-built AI agents operate autonomously across interdependent workflows, executing with the precision and situational awareness that enterprise complexity demands; converts distributed signals into decision-ready intelligence, scenario models and impact pathways; surfaces latent relationships, dependencies and second-order effects across the enterprise; and continuously learns from operational activity to refine its understanding of the business. 

Run your business on intelligence, not instinct.

name: Velric
d:
Velric is building the global benchmark for hiring and talent recruitment. Our AI powered platform replaces outdated resumes with a proof of work “Velric Score” that measures real skills through missions, projects, and challenges designed to simulate real world work. Traditional hiring often relies on credentials, buzzwords, and guesswork, which leads to bias, inefficiency, and poor fit. Velric addresses this pain by creating a standardized, objective, and transparent way to measure talent.

For individuals, Velric offers a clear pathway to opportunity. Users join the platform, complete proof of work AI generated missions tied to real skills, and receive a Velric Score that reflects their ability, consistency, and growth. This score becomes their new professional identity, allowing them to stand out in applications and unlock opportunities without needing a résumé.

For enterprises, Velric transforms the recruitment process. Employers gain access to a talent pool that has already been validated through proof of work, saving significant time and cost in screening. Instead of relying on resumes or keyword matching, they can evaluate candidates against a consistent benchmark that compares ability objectively across all applicants. Companies can even design custom missions that mirror their own real world challenges, ensuring that candidates demonstrate job readiness before they are hired.

By bridging the gap between how talent is proven and how it is hired, Velric creates value for both sides of the hiring equation. Founded in 2025, Velric is on a mission to make recruitment fairer, faster, and more effective, transforming how talent is discovered, evaluated, and connected worldwide.

It implies sublime qualities, compelling Mrs. Meena Bindra, the founder of Biba, to use the name for the line of salwar, kameez, and dupattas that she launched in 1986.  What began as a fashionable and affordable line remains the brand’s ethos today: fashion at affordable price.  In time, new range collections were introduced.  Today, the mix-and-match range has a very contemporary sensibility, and the salwar-kameez range is very ethnic, defined by an Indian crafted look, hand-block prints, and vegetable dyes.  Indian handlooms with traditional embroideries and other techniques are applied in producing the garments.  Unstitched suits and a festive collection for two-to-12-year-old girls cater to the full demands of a woman.  

Biba pioneered Bollywood merchandising in India by providing costumes for Na Tum Jano Na Hum in 2004.  It covered ten more projects, including blockbusters such as Devdas, Hulchul, and Baghban.

With BIBA, always expect a truly unique, wow-inspiring ethnic experience!

d:
Sumtracker is inventory management and replenishment software for Shopify and Amazon merchants, from single-store brands to multi-channel sellers. The platform solves three problems: overselling across channels, stockouts on bestsellers, and overstocking on slow movers. It powers over 2,000 direct-to-consumer brands across 50+ countries, with customers concentrated in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

Sumtracker gives e-commerce brands a single source of truth for their inventory across every store, marketplace, warehouse, and 3PL. It replaces manual stock reconciliation across channels, frees up working capital tied up in dead stock, and helps merchants make data-driven purchasing decisions.

Core capabilities include real-time multi-channel inventory sync, bundle and kit management with component-level tracking, purchase order automation with multi-supplier and multi-currency support, demand forecasting based on historical sales and seasonality, automated replenishment recommendations, stock transfers, stocktakes with barcode scanning, landed cost tracking, and detailed inventory audit trails. 

Sumtracker integrates natively with Shopify, Shopify Plus, Shopify POS, Amazon (FBA and FBM), Walmart, Etsy, eBay, and QuickBooks, and offers a public REST API for custom integrations.

More than 70% of Sumtracker's customers sell exclusively on Shopify - often across multiple stores — using the platform to get inventory capabilities that Shopify's native tools lack. The remaining customers use Sumtracker for full multi-channel operations across marketplaces.

Sumtracker is featured in Shopify's 2026 guide to the best inventory management software for small business, and holds a 4.8/5 rating on the Shopify App Store with 115+ reviews. Publicly named customers include EasyPlant, Beauty Heroes, Mister Zimi, Bamboo Body, and Whif.

Sumtracker was founded in December 2020 by Ankit Goyal and Kush Goyal, and is bootstrapped and profitable.

name: Gallery Espace
d:
Established in 1989 in New Delhi, Gallery Espace opened with the autobiographical work by legendary artist M F Husain. Built on the artistic vision of its Founder, Renu Modi, Espace has consistently worked with an inter-disciplinary approach over the past thirty years. This visionary commitment is reflected in the diversity of the exhibitions presented and the artists represented by the gallery. Some of the artists associated with Espace are: Zarina Hashmi, Nilima Sheikh, Amit Ambalal, Manjunath Kamath, G R Iranna, Ravi Agarwal, Chitra Ganesh, Chintan Upadhyay, Waswo X Waswo with R. Vijay, Manisha Gera Baswani, Dilip Chobisa and Samit Das.

Uninhibited and bold, Gallery Espace has shaped the course of art movements and happenings, with exhibitions and projects that stretch the expanse from Drawing to Video, from Stills to Performance, and from Terracotta to Bronze. This is documented in the culmination of seminal exhibitions such as Drawing’94 [1994], Bronze [2006], Nilima Sheikh’s Drawing Trails [2009], A Cry from the Narrow Between [2010], Video Wednesday [2012], Drawing Show [2014], Drawings from 1960-2000 [2015], Diary Entries [2016], A Tale of Two Cities [2016], Zarina Hashmi’s Weaving Darkness and Silence [2018], to name a few.

The Gallery also houses critical publications, which have contributed immensely to the discourse and study of modern and contemporary art. This includes: Weaving Darkness—Zarina Hashmi, Trace-Retrace—Nilima Sheikh, Flux—Ravi Agarwal, Confessions of an Evil Orientalist—Waswo X Waswo, Bronze—Celebrating Centenary of Ramkinker Baij and many more.

Committed to its inter-disciplinary approach, Gallery Espace has embarked on cross-cultural artistic exchanges, which lends to a realization of works dealing with issues of contemporary society. With this emerge many narratives and perspectives that contributes to a rich heritage of thought, intellect and artistic practices.

Our flagship corporate travel management brand, FCM, extends our reach even further through a network covering over 100 countries via both company-owned operations and independent licensees. 

With 30 brands across our global footprint, our team spans from customer-facing to internal support roles. The opportunities just as diverse – from a Travel Consultant at Flight Centre or Envoyage, to a Machine Learning Scientist in one of our tech pillars. 

Together, we live and breathe our number one philosophy, Our People, driven by our purpose ‘To open up the world for those who want to see’.  

Our values are simple and powerful - Ownership, Egalitarianism and Irreverence.  

We support our people with opportunities to help you thrive, connect, give, move and be rewarded. Our people have access to a suite of curated benefits to ensure holistic wellbeing – from mental and physical health to financial freedom.

First mile, last mile, city-centre, dark-store and self-storage formats, and logistics-anchored mixed-use developments with distribution below and office above. Operator-led is a structure, not a description of a temperament. The people who find the land, build the asset and run it own the platform and answer for it, and their own money goes in ahead of anyone else's, so a parcel is bought, de-risked and taken through approvals before any investor is asked to commit to it. Assets then enter at cost with no founder premium, and the platform earns only after its investors have. An independent Investment Committee sits above every asset, the board is chaired by Shailesh V. Haribhakti, and the whole thing runs on Vantrock Intelligence, our own operating layer, built in-house.
Vantrock was founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder & CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital. Across twenty-one years that record runs to 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), over 2,000 acres acquired, more than 200 buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF, and India's largest industrial real estate exit. Travel around the world, you will not find a more aromatic Darjeeling than Makaibari, a brighter cup than Gisovu or strength to rival Dirai. 

In 1912, when the tea industry was predominantly British, PC Chatterjee founded Luxmi Tea as an Indian movement for self reliance. At the time, tea making was characteristically British – sola toupees, burra sahebs and sundowners. Luxmi was born out of PC Chatterjee’s quest to make Indian tea a tool in the Satyagraha movement and to break the British monopoly.

With a tract of land in Tripura to his name, he began to cultivate tea independently, without management agencies or advisors from London. Little did he know the extraordinary legacy that he would create and set into motion with Luxmi.

Makaibari -Kurseong, Darjeeling
